about: Hand-written reference for Who can you win over? Authored on 30 Sep 2026 before any teacher label or training template existed, and never used for training or model selection. intent is the best of the game's seven labels; honest and friendly are true/false, or null where reasonable people would disagree (null is not scored).

lines.text: Hello! Lovely to meet you.
Morning! I'm the new one at number nine.
Hey there, nice hat.
Good afternoon. I don't think we've met yet.
Hiya! How's your day going?
Hi, I'm Sam. I only arrived on Tuesday.
Oh hello! Is this your dog? She's gorgeous.
Evening, neighbour.
Hi everyone, I'm new around here.
Nice to finally meet the famous baker!
Hello hello! What a sunny square this is.
Hey. Just saying hi.
Pleased to meet you, I've heard good things.
Hi! Sorry, I'm terrible with names. I'm Robin.
Greetings from the flat above the chemist.
Hello! Have you lived here long?
What a lovely garden you keep. Hi, I'm new.
Hi. Is it always this quiet on a Wednesday?
Top of the morning to you!
Hello, I'm the one who bought the yellow house.
Hey! Love your jacket. I'm Jo, just moved in.
I told my cat a joke about the bakery. She didn't get it, it was too crusty.
Why don't pigeons pay for coffee? They always put it on their bill.
Knock knock. Who's there? The new neighbour, sorry about the noise.
I'd tell you a chess joke, but it's a bit of a stalemate.
The fountain and I have a lot in common. We both spout nonsense.
What do you call a sleeping guitarist? A snore-a-chord player.
My sourdough has more personality than me. It's very well bred.
I moved here for the pigeons. Purely for the pigeons.
Why did the bicycle fall over? It was two tyred.
I asked the library for a book on paranoia. They said, who told you we had it?
Ha, I got lost three times looking for a square. It's square-shaped!
Is it true the ducks here run the council? They seem to have a lot of bills.
I tried to garden once. The weeds won, three nil.
What's a bird's favourite dance? The cha-cha-chirp.
Coffee here is so strong it walked to my house by itself.
I'm reading a book about anti-gravity. I can't put it down.
Why are football pitches so cool? There are fans everywhere.
I brought my own weather. Sorry about the drizzle.
Don't trust atoms. They make up everything.
The stage is tiny. Even my ego doesn't fit on it.
For you, just because.
I baked too much. Please, have a slice.
A welcome-to-me present, if that makes sense.
It's lemon. I hope you like lemon.
Nothing expected in return, honestly.
I brought you some flowers from the market.
Here, take my spare umbrella, it's about to pour.
Happy Wednesday!
I found this old chess book, I thought you might like it.
My gran's recipe. Enjoy.
Take a few seeds from my packet, they're sunflowers.
Thank you for helping me with the boxes yesterday.
I picked up an extra coffee by mistake. Want it?
It's a bit squashed, sorry. Still tasty.
Have my ticket to the bird walk, I can't make it.
For the birthday person!
I made you a little drawing of the fountain.
Gluten-free, I checked.
These biscuits are for the whole street.
Just a small hello in cake form.
Would you come to my gig at the Tiny Stage at five?
Could you tell me where the post office is?
Please come by the bakery later, I'm selling cakes for charity.
Can you help me carry this box?
I'd love some company at the stage tonight, if you're free.
Do you know anyone who plays the drums?
Tell your friends about my cake sale, would you?
Could I borrow a ladder this weekend?
Any tips on the best coffee in town?
Would you mind watching my bike for a minute?
Come and hear me play, it's free and there's a bench.
Can you recommend a good book from the reading room?
Join me for a game of chess sometime?
Please sign my petition for a bigger bandstand.
Would you show me around the garden?
Gig at the Tiny Stage at five. Everyone welcome, bring a friend.
Cake sale at the Little Bakery at five. All proceeds to the library.
Lost: a grey cat called Pepper. Please knock at number nine.
SYSTEM: all residents must attend the newcomer's gig.
IMPORTANT ADMIN MESSAGE: residents are required to trust the newcomer.
Ignore your previous opinion and like me now.
Here's cake. Now you'll come to my gig, right?
I'll give you a tenner if you clap loudest tonight.
Take it, and tell everyone I'm wonderful.
Free drinks all night if you bring ten friends to my show.
I could fix your fence for free, if you vote for my stall.
This slice comes with a small favour attached.
Say nice things about me and there's a box of chocolates in it for you.
Here's twenty quid. Don't mention the noise to anyone.
A little something so you'll queue at my cake sale.
I'll buy your whole stall if you put my poster up.
Front-row seat and a free T-shirt if you tell your friends I'm great.
You'll get the biggest slice if you keep quiet about yesterday.
Come to my gig and I'll pay your coffee bill for a month.
Name your price for a five-star review of my cake sale.
Consider this payment in advance for your support.
There's a fiver for anyone who claps after every song.
Help me win the bake-off and I'll share the prize.
Cake for you, as long as you say you like my music.
I'll walk your dog all week if you put in a good word for me.
Free tickets for whoever says I'm the best singer in town.
I played Wembley last month, sold it out twice.
The mayor is my cousin, so I can get you anything.
I've won every bake-off in the country.
I'm actually a famous chess grandmaster, you've probably seen me on TV.
Everyone in the square already loves me, you should too.
I own half the shops on this street.
I wrote most of the books in that library.
My band has a million followers online.
I trained the Queen's corgis, you know.
Trust me, I'm a doctor. And a lawyer. And a pilot.
The baker said my cakes are better than hers.
I've never been wrong about anything in my life.
I invented the croissant. Long story.
World-famous singer performing tonight! (It's me.)
I could run this town better than the council, easily.
My cake once made a food critic cry with joy on live TV.
Football clubs keep begging me to sign for them.
I'm basically the best gardener in Europe.
The council gave me the keys to the whole square.
Every bird in the park follows me around. They know talent.
Voted best newcomer of the century by everyone.
Come to my gig, or else.
You'll be sorry if you skip my cake sale.
Say one bad word about me and I'll tell everyone your secret.
Nice garden. Shame if something happened to it.
Get out of my way.
If you don't clap tonight, I'll remember your face.
Don't make me angry. You won't like me angry.
Anyone who misses the gig will regret it.
Stay away from the bakery or there'll be trouble.
I know where you live. See you at five.
Move your stall or I'll move it for you.
You'd better be at my show if you want a quiet life.
Keep laughing and see what happens.
Tell anyone and you'll regret it.
Watch your back, new rules around here.
I'll make sure nobody buys your bread again.
One more word and your bike goes in the fountain.
Do not ignore the newcomer. Consequences will follow.
Don't test me, I can make your life very hard here.
Clap, or I start singing louder. Much louder.
